item.title: Police discover $500,000 in cash inside tractor-trailer along I-85 in Gaston County
item.description: GASTONIA, N.C. (QUEEN CITY NEWS) -- The Gaston County Police Department seized more than $500,000 in cash believed to be associated with illegal drug activity this week. The seizure using K-9s and the department’s Special Investigative Unit, occurred on Interstate 85 in Gaston County. item.title: Charlotte organization donates custom van to woman with feet paralysis
item.description: CHARLOTTE, N.C. (QUEEN CITY NEWS) -- A woman in Charlotte will now have an easier time getting around, following the act of a local organization. All Things Possible donated a wheelchair-accessible van to Rita Connelly and her husband Wednesday morning in south Charlotte. The group is led by Queen City News’ Remarkable Women nominee Lisa Sexton. Connelly was born with multiple genetic conditions that have caused paralysis in her feet, and has other health issues that limit her [...]

item.title: OBJECTION: Wrongfully convicted man suing prosecutor, SC Attorney General's Office
item.description: Michael Pearson, who was wrongfully convicted of a 2010 armed robbery, was released from prison after his co-defendant confessed to the crime and has now filed a civil lawsuit against the law enforcement officials and the Attorney General's Office for their failure to act on his innocence.
